start.speaker: Stranded scout
start.text: Another umbral. You have the look. Relit and sent down, and nobody told you what the lamp runs on.

lamp.speaker: Stranded scout
lamp.text: The store. The Chapter put the daylight somewhere and it has been paying out ever since. You are a withdrawal. So am I, and I am nearly spent.

squad.speaker: Stranded scout
squad.text: Two rooms back, and they are still there, and they are still standing. Take the scrap and watch the captain's parry — he was always better at it than he was at anything else.

paid.speaker: Stranded scout
paid.text: That is my share, earned and witnessed. Keep it separate from whatever scrap you find in these halls.
